premises.text: Creators are being treated unfairly on existing platforms due to inconsistent monetization and content restrictions
premises.evidence_span: you're being treated in a way that doesn't seem fair. So, you're consistently being demonetized for difficult-to-diagnose and really hard-to-change ways.

premises.text: Consumers are overwhelmed by irrelevant advertising and abusive comments on existing platforms
premises.evidence_span: you're being inundated with irrelevant and irritating advertising, and you also, even when you want to show support to your favorite creators, aren't able to do it because the comment section is filled with what seems to just be abuse hurled at your favorite creator.

premises.text: A creator-first video-sharing platform can empower creators and enhance consumer experience
premises.evidence_span: We are a creator-first video-sharing platform, rewarding and empowering creators while creating a more social, safe experience for the consumer.

premises.text: Kubernetes allows the platform to scale efficiently based on traffic demands
premises.evidence_span: we've built our entire back-end upon a system called Kubernetes, which allows us to scale down to really, really low amounts of costs when we've not got much traffic, but also scale up when we are experiencing traffic spikes or even in the event of something like an attack.

premises.text: The platform can support millions of uploads per day
premises.evidence_span: Our processing pipeline has been built to support millions of uploads per day.

premises.text: A moderation system can protect users from inappropriate content and copyright issues
premises.evidence_span: we've also built an exciting moderation piece which protects users from things like inappropriate content and also areas like copyrights.

premises.text: An interestingness algorithm can suggest relevant and safe content to users
premises.evidence_span: our interestingness algorithm, which has been a coin phrase from my personal favorite YouTuber, Casey Neistat, which is basically around suggesting relevant, entertaining, and safe posts to the user.

premises.text: A micro-subscription model can provide a new revenue stream for creators
premises.evidence_span: SuperSub, which is a creator-driven micro-subscription model.

premises.text: Advertising can be controlled by creators to enhance monetization
premises.evidence_span: advertising, a more traditional method that the creator controls.

premises.text: Focusing on emerging markets can drive user growth and engagement
premises.evidence_span: we are focusing on the emerging markets, South America, Russia, the Middle East, and India.

premises.text: Exclusive content agreements with influential creators can enhance platform appeal
premises.evidence_span: they have signed an agreement with us to say they're posting exclusive content.

value.text: Creators and consumers benefit from a fairer, safer, and more engaging video-sharing platform
value.evidence_span: rewarding and empowering creators while creating a more social, safe experience for the consumer.

notes: Traction metrics and investor mentions excluded as they do not support premises.
